info.title: PhoneKit - Phone Number Validation, Carrier & Line Type
info.description:
# PhoneKit: Phone Number Validation, Carrier and Line Type

Validate, normalise and enrich phone numbers for 240+ countries and territories: E.164 formatting, line type (mobile, landline, VoIP, toll-free, premium), region, location, original carrier and time zones. Offline and instant, with no per-lookup carrier fees.

**Who it's for:** signup and checkout forms, CRMs, SMS and voice platforms, and fraud teams who need clean, comparable numbers.

## Use cases
- Normalise every number to E.164 before storing it or sending SMS.
- Reject landlines or premium-rate numbers where only mobiles will work.
- Flag VoIP numbers on signup as a fraud signal.
- Show the right local time before calling a customer.
- Clean and de-duplicate a contact list with /bulk.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://phonekit-phone-number-validation-carrier-line-type.p.rapidapi.com/validate?number=%2B447911123456' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: phonekit-phone-number-validation-carrier-line-type.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`phonekit-phone-number-validation-carrier-line-type.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- Validation is based on numbering-plan metadata; it confirms a number is valid and allocated, not that it is currently connected or reachable.
- `carrier` is the original network for the range; ported numbers keep their original carrier name.
- `+` must be URL-encoded as `%2B` in query strings.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `413` input too large, `422` missing or invalid parameter. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- Numbering-plan, geocoding, carrier and time-zone metadata from Google's libphonenumber (via the phonenumbers library), Apache 2.0 licence.

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

tags.name: Phone numbers

tags.name: MCP
tags.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint that exposes this API's endpoints as tools for AI agents.

get.summary: Validate and format a phone number
get.description: Parses a number written in any common style (spaces, dashes, brackets, leading 0 or +), checks it against the numbering plan, and returns E.164, international, national and tel: formats, line type (mobile, fixed line, VoIP, toll-free, premium rate and so on), region, location, original carrier and time zones. Unparseable input returns 200 with `valid: false` and an `error` message.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Phone number in international (+44 7911 123456) or national (07911 123456) form. URL-encode `+` as `%2B`; a `+` that arrives as a space is restored. Max 40 characters are read. `phone` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Default region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) used to interpret national-format numbers without a + prefix. Not needed for numbers in + format.

post.description: Validates and formats up to 100 numbers in one request. Results are returned in input order with the same fields as /validate. Invalid entries do not fail the batch.

numbers.description: 1-100 phone numbers (strings). Each is read up to 40 characters.

country.description: Default ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region for national-format numbers.

results.error: The string supplied did not seem to be a phone number.

422.description: `numbers` missing, empty or not an array.

get.summary: Get an example number for a country
get.description: Returns a valid example fixed-line number for the country, fully parsed. Handy for input placeholders and test fixtures.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. GB, US, DE.

example.error: country must be an ISO 3166 alpha-2 code like GB

post.summary: MCP server (PhoneKit tools for AI agents)

Error.description: Error body. Errors raised by the API itself carry an `error` string. Errors raised by the RapidAPI gateway (missing or invalid key, not subscribed, quota or rate limit exceeded) carry a `message` string instead.

PhoneNumber.description: Parsed phone number. When the input cannot be parsed at all, only `input`, `valid` (false), `possible` (false) and `error` are returned.

valid.description: Number is valid for its region according to current numbering-plan metadata (right length, allocated prefix).

possible.description: Number has a plausible length for the region (a weaker check than `valid`).

error.description: Why parsing failed (only when the input is not a phone number).

national_number.description: National significant number without the country code.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region the number belongs to (may be a territory sharing the code, e.g. GG, JE, IM for +44).

location.description: Geographic description (city, area or country) where known.

carrier.description: Original mobile carrier for the number range, where known. Does not reflect number porting.

timezones.description: IANA time zones the number may be in.

results.description: One entry per input number, in order.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: the request did not arrive through the RapidAPI gateway, or your RapidAPI key is not subscribed to this API.

example.message: You are not subscribed to this API.

ValidationError.description: Unprocessable: a required parameter is missing or a value is invalid. The `error` text says which.

example.error: A required parameter is missing or invalid

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests: your RapidAPI plan's rate limit or monthly quota was exceeded. Back off and retry, or upgrade your plan.

example.message: You have exceeded the rate limit per second for your plan, BASIC, by the API provider

RapidAPIKey.name: X-RapidAPI-Key
